Set wallpaper from an image file

Usage: wayle wallpaper set [OPTIONS] <PATH>

Arguments:
  <PATH>  Path to wallpaper image

Options:
  -f, --fit <FIT>          Image fit mode [possible values: fill, fit, center, tile, stretch]
      --monitor <MONITOR>  Target monitor (e.g., DP-1, HDMI-A-1). If omitted, applies to all monitors
  -h, --help               Print help (see more with '--help')
